title: Make Your Own Character: Create an Original Character from Scratch
summary: Make your own character from scratch: design their look, personality and backstory, then pick an app to bring them to life. A free, step-by-step original character guide.
body_markdown:
Making your own character isn’t about finding the right preset. It’s about deciding who someone is, then giving them a look that shows it. This guide walks through creating an original character from scratch, in any art style and with any app.


*Redbean is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any of the apps or companies named here. App names are trademarks of their owners. No official artwork is used on this page.*


Table of Contents


Toggle


##


Step 1: Start with a core idea (not a look)


#


Write one sentence: **who they are and what they want.**


> “A night-shift baker who wants to open her own shop but is afraid of being seen.”


Everything else should support that sentence.


##


Step 2: Personality


#


- **Three traits** , including one flaw. For example: warm, stubborn, secretly anxious.
- **A habit or quirk** people notice.
- **How they talk:** short and blunt, or rambling and kind?
- **What they’d never do.** Limits make characters believable.


##


Step 3: Backstory (keep it short)


#


Answer just four questions:
1. Where did they grow up?
2. What happened that shaped them?
3. Who matters most to them?
4. What are they hiding?


You can add more later. A short backstory you actually use beats ten pages you don’t.


##


Step 4: Design the look


#


Now let the personality drive the design:
– **Silhouette:** a recognizable shape (hair, coat, posture).
– **Palette:** 3–4 colors that fit the mood.
– **One signature detail:** an accessory, mark or item tied to the backstory.
– **Art style:** any style works. Pick the one you can repeat consistently.


##


Step 5: Pick an app for the stage you’re at


#


Stage Good options (all free to download)


Quick face or portrait Picrew PFP & OC Maker, Dollify


Full body plus scenes Gacha Life 2, Gacha Club

Store details checked on the US App Store and Google Play on October 24, 2026. Prices and labels can change, so check the listing before you download.


##


Step 6: Write a character sheet


#


Put it all on one page: name, age, one-line core, traits, backstory answers, palette and signature detail. Use our[free OC template](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-template/) .


##


Step 7: Bring them to life


#


Characters grow when they meet other characters. Put yours in a scene, a story or a world, and see what changes. Redbean is free to download. Its App Store listing describes it as a place where your original characters live in a town together, build relationships, visit places, react to events and create stories.


##


Common mistakes


#


- **Design first, personality never.** The character looks great but has nothing to say.
- **Too many “special” traits.** Pick one thing that makes them unusual.
- **No flaw.** Flaws drive story.
- **No consistency.** Keep the sheet and reuse the palette.


##


FAQ


#


**How do I make my own character for free?** Plan the personality and backstory on paper (free), then design the look in a free-to-download app such as Picrew, Dollify or Gacha Life 2.


**Can I make my own character without drawing?** Yes. Portrait makers, Gacha-style creators and 3D avatar apps all work without drawing skills.


**What’s an OC?** OC means original character. Our[OC maker guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/oc-maker/) covers it in more depth.
